purpose: Delivers brief temporary notifications through a shared queue and landmark region.

notes: Mount Toast Region once inside VeliProvider for localized direction and close text.

useWhen: A brief global notification should appear without interrupting the current task.
Application events need queued notification delivery.

avoidWhen.situation: The message must remain near related page content.
The user must make a blocking decision.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use a modal with explicit actions.

supportedInteractions: Navigate and close notifications through the toast region.
approvedPatterns: Create and share one toast queue.
Mount one Toast Region near the application root.
Use at least five seconds for auto-dismiss notifications.
Keep action-bearing or important notifications open until dismissed.
Use stable action ids when labels are not stable primitive values.
limitations: Timeout progress only renders for a timed queue entry with an active timer.
Toast uses React Aria unstable toast primitives.
Actions dismiss by default unless explicitly configured otherwise.
accessibility: Use a concise title and optional supporting description.
Keep actionable notifications persistent so users have time to respond.
The close control has provider-localized notification text.
The visual timeout progress bar is hidden from assistive technology.
responsive: Toasts cap their width and regions use viewport insets.
Start and end placements adapt to logical direction.
rtl: Provider direction is applied to the toast region and each toast.
Use start or end placement names rather than physical sides.
